name: component-contract-props
goal: Component contracts call arguments props and omit the function return output section

evidence: The component Contract view currently shares callable labels: the generated EntityHeader screenshot shows its framework-state list as a contract row. Expected component contracts label declared inputs as Props and omit output/return groups; function contracts retain Parameters and Returns.

The standardized component Contract browser test already visits OrderList's selected revision, but only asserted that States is absent. It never asserted field-section semantics. Extend that reusable real-browser scenario using its shared fixture (orders and searchText props plus markup return), capture the same contract state, and assert Props is present while Inputs and Outputs are absent. Current main also omits the stale States row; this request concerns the remaining generic component headings.

Test-only commit 9ff568a95389ed6c76caa90422ee57a3bf9d6ddb was tested in a clean Harness snapshot. The unchanged browser regression failed at the Props-table visibility assertion because the actual contract table was labeled Inputs. Screenshot and source-tree-bound red record are stored through Harness regression history.

Components now expose their declared inputs as Props and omit return/output fields in both contract summaries and detail tables; functions, pages, services and configs retain their existing section meanings. Focused contract unit tests passed 16/16 and the unchanged Playwright regression passed before the fix commit; Svelte check, audit and formatting passed.

Harness recorded the unchanged browser regression red at test-only commit b398c1604 (record f904804e) and green at fix commit 085a2f6e9 (record fc7588b6). Both use the same test corpus, command, runtime profile, and screenshot checkpoint. The passing run followed the latest main base 23fa2679d.

On branch commit 085a2f6e9, after rebasing onto main 23fa2679d, bun run --cwd packages/reports check passed: format:check, typecheck, lint, 161 unit files / 650 tests, build, and Harness audit. The unchanged Playwright browser regression was recorded red at test-only commit b398c1604 (record f904804e) and green at fix commit 085a2f6e9 (record fc7588b6), using the same test corpus, command, runtime profile, and screenshot checkpoint. Fresh screenshot /tmp/harness-component-contract-props-final/component-contract-props-no-output-desktop.png visually shows the Props table and no Inputs/Outputs.
